evaluations.evidence: view a list of sponsors
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes sponsor creation/management and sponsorship purchase flows, so sponsor data can exist to be listed.

evaluations.evidence: view a list of user profiles
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes user registration and profile update, enabling profiles to exist and be viewed.

evaluations.evidence: email all the trainers at once
evaluations.rationale: Requires a defined way to identify/maintain the set of 'trainers' (role assignment or trainer roster). Backlog has trainer-facing capabilities but no story to create/assign trainer role or manage trainer list, so the bulk-email target group may not exist.

evaluations.evidence: have a very clear map where the buildings and rooms are
evaluations.rationale: Venue/location management exists, which can supply building/room/location data for maps.

evaluations.evidence: edit my training node myself
evaluations.rationale: Editing implies the training node already exists and is associated to the trainer. Backlog provides training listing/detail pages but no story to create trainings or assign trainers ownership/permissions for a training node.

evaluations.evidence: limit to one registration per day per authenticated user
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes training registration-related workflows (waitlist, cancellation terms/deadline, viewing signed-up trainings), implying a registration capability exists to constrain.

evaluations.evidence: admin view that helps track registration status for each attendee ... attended, refunded, no show
evaluations.rationale: Tracking 'refunded' requires a refund capability for training registrations; backlog has refund for sponsorship via Stripe but no explicit training registration refund story, leaving a complementary capability gap for the statuses listed.

evaluations.evidence: be added to a training waitlist
evaluations.rationale: Waitlist complements training registration; backlog contains multiple training registration workflow stories indicating registration exists.

evaluations.evidence: must accept the cancellation terms with a checkbox
evaluations.rationale: This is an addition to an existing registration/cancellation workflow, which is referenced elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: tie in a cancellation deadline to whatever registration / cancellation workflow exists
evaluations.rationale: Backlog references cancellation but does not include an explicit story enabling trainees to cancel a training registration (the workflow is assumed but not specified), creating a complementary capability gap.

evaluations.evidence: add to "my schedule" if there is a schedule feature on the site
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes viewing the overall schedule but no story to create/manage a personal schedule feature (add/remove items, view personal schedule). This story exposes the missing complementary personal-schedule capability.

evaluations.evidence: see which trainings I have signed up for
evaluations.rationale: Training registration is implied by training detail pages with 'link to register' and other registration workflow stories, enabling a signed-up list to exist.

evaluations.evidence: view ... shows all attendee information
evaluations.rationale: Requires that attendees can register for trainings and that attendee info is captured for those registrations. Backlog lacks an explicit story for training registration itself (only links/workflow constraints), so the underlying attendee list may not be created.

evaluations.evidence: admin view where all trainee information is shown and can be filtered to show a single training session
evaluations.rationale: Depends on captured trainee registration data per training session. Backlog does not explicitly include creating training registrations (only constraints and views), leaving a complementary capability gap.

evaluations.evidence: link to register for class
evaluations.rationale: Story requires a training registration capability, but backlog does not contain an explicit story to register for a training/class (only constraints like one-per-day, waitlist, cancellation terms, and views). Missing complementary 'register for training' behavior.

evaluations.evidence: register now link
evaluations.rationale: Exposes the same gap as BC-015: a concrete training registration story is missing, despite multiple stories assuming registrations exist.

evaluations.evidence: promote call for trainings
evaluations.rationale: A 'call for trainings' implies a submission/creation workflow for training offerings, but backlog lacks stories for proposing/submitting/creating trainings (distinct from sessions).

evaluations.evidence: link on the home page to a list of training options
evaluations.rationale: Training list/landing pages exist in backlog, so a home-page link is complementary and not blocked by missing core capability.

evaluations.evidence: find out where the coding lounge is and what time it is open
evaluations.rationale: Requires content/data about the coding lounge location and hours, but backlog has no story to create/maintain coding lounge info (as a venue, page, or schedule item).

evaluations.evidence: refund sponsorship money that was processed via stripe
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes sponsorship payment flows, providing the prerequisite of Stripe-processed sponsorship payments to refund.

evaluations.evidence: link ... to become a $350 level sponsor
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes the capability to pay for and become a $350 company sponsor.

evaluations.evidence: See a list of attendees associated with this company
evaluations.rationale: Requires a way to associate attendees/users with a company/sponsor organization. Backlog has linking attendees to sponsorship page but not a story to capture/maintain attendee-to-company affiliation.

evaluations.evidence: identify myself as and pay for a $350 company sponsorship
evaluations.rationale: Payment entry/charging and sponsorship level discovery exist, supporting this sponsorship purchase capability.

evaluations.evidence: create and maintain venues
evaluations.rationale: Venue details viewing exists, providing complementary read capability for created venues.

evaluations.evidence: view venue details
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes venue creation/maintenance, so venue data can exist to view.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of the sessions associated with sponsor attendees
evaluations.rationale: Requires (1) mapping attendees to a sponsor/company and (2) mapping attendees to sessions they are involved with/attending. Backlog lacks explicit attendee-to-company association and lacks session attendance/registration by attendees.

evaluations.evidence: See a payment page ... third step of the registration process
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes entering payment info and charging for individual sponsorships, supporting the payment step.

evaluations.evidence: assign sponsors to events, trainings and summits
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes sponsor detail viewing and viewing what a sponsor sponsors, which complements assignment.

evaluations.evidence: see all events, trainings and summits that a sponsor is sponsoring
evaluations.rationale: Sponsor-to-entity assignment exists, enabling this listing.

evaluations.evidence: Enter payment information and have my card charged
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes sponsorship purchase flows that require charging a card; refund capability also exists for sponsorships, indicating end-to-end payment lifecycle.

evaluations.evidence: link BADCamp attendees to my sponsorship page
evaluations.rationale: Requires a mechanism for sponsors/admins to associate specific attendee accounts with a sponsor/company. Backlog has no explicit story to create/manage that association.

evaluations.evidence: update my user profile
evaluations.rationale: User accounts are created via registration, enabling profiles to exist and be updated.

evaluations.evidence: sign up for the BADCamp newsletter
evaluations.rationale: Requires a newsletter system (subscription storage and sending/management). Backlog contains no complementary stories for creating/sending newsletters or managing subscriber lists.

evaluations.evidence: tag my blog posts
evaluations.rationale: Blog post creation exists, providing the content to tag.

evaluations.evidence: create blog posts
evaluations.rationale: Reading the blog exists, complementing creation.

evaluations.evidence: read the blog
evaluations.rationale: Blog post creation exists, so there is content to read.

evaluations.evidence: sponsor a summit
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes summit sponsor listing and summit info, but lacks an explicit capability for a sponsor to purchase/commit to summit sponsorship (payment/selection workflow) analogous to company/individual sponsorship purchase.

evaluations.evidence: register for a summit
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes viewing seats left, viewing what summits I'm signed up for, and coordinator attendee lists, which together imply summit registration exists.

evaluations.evidence: get detailed directions to the summit venue
evaluations.rationale: Venue creation/maintenance and venue detail viewing exist, supporting directions content.

evaluations.evidence: see what summits I'm signed up for
evaluations.rationale: Summit registration and coordinator attendee list stories imply sign-ups exist to be listed per user.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of attendees signed up for my summit
evaluations.rationale: Requires a way to identify/assign 'summit coordinator' role and associate a coordinator with a summit. Backlog has coordinator stories but no complementary story to create/assign that role or link coordinators to summits.

evaluations.evidence: As a summit coordinator, I want to list basic information about my summit
evaluations.rationale: Assumes a summit exists and is owned/managed by a summit coordinator. Backlog lacks a story to create a summit and/or assign a coordinator to manage it.

evaluations.evidence: list sponsors for my summit
evaluations.rationale: Requires (1) summit existence/ownership by coordinator and (2) a way to add/assign sponsors to a summit. Backlog has sponsor assignment to summits (admin) but lacks summit creation/coordination linkage.

evaluations.evidence: list an agenda for my summit
evaluations.rationale: Requires summit existence and coordinator management linkage; backlog lacks explicit summit creation/management assignment.

evaluations.evidence: see how many seats are left for the summit
evaluations.rationale: Summit registration exists in backlog, enabling seat counts to change and be displayed.

evaluations.evidence: see specific details on summits ... register for the event
evaluations.rationale: Summit detail viewing depends on summit content existing. Backlog lacks an explicit story to create/maintain summits (only coordinator listing info/agenda/sponsors), leaving summit creation/maintenance capability unclear/missing.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of all the summits
evaluations.rationale: Listing requires summits to be created/maintained. Backlog has coordinator stories to list info but no explicit summit creation/administration story establishing summits.

evaluations.evidence: learn about sponsorship levels
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes sponsorship purchase at specific levels, so sponsorship levels are part of the system and can be described.

evaluations.evidence: use a WYSIWYG editor for all long-form content
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes long-form content creation/maintenance (e.g., blog posts, summit info), so providing an editor is complementary and not blocked by missing core capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: Link to my sponsorship profile from my job listings
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes sponsor job posting and sponsor sponsorship profile/personalization, enabling linking between them.

evaluations.evidence: learn about posting jobs as a sponsor and contact the sponsorship person
evaluations.rationale: Job posting by sponsors exists, so informational/contact page is complementary.

evaluations.evidence: post a job
evaluations.rationale: Job board viewing exists, complementing job creation.

evaluations.evidence: view the job board
evaluations.rationale: Job posting exists, so there is content to view.

evaluations.evidence: assign a room to a time slot and a location
evaluations.rationale: Schedule viewing exists, so schedule population is complemented by a read capability.

evaluations.evidence: see the schedule
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes admin actions to populate the schedule (assign rooms/time slots; accept sessions), enabling a schedule to exist.

evaluations.evidence: see the final list of sessions approved
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes session submission and acceptance/approval actions, enabling an approved list to exist.

evaluations.evidence: bulk approve sessions as accepted
evaluations.rationale: Session submission exists, providing sessions to approve.

evaluations.evidence: mark a session as accepted
evaluations.rationale: Session submission exists, providing sessions to accept.

evaluations.evidence: receive a notification when sessions have been evaluated
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes session acceptance/evaluation actions, which can trigger notifications.

evaluations.evidence: receive a notification when I submit a session
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes session submission, enabling a submission event to notify on.

evaluations.evidence: edit my session
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes session submission, so sessions exist to be edited by the submitter.

evaluations.evidence: register to speak ... submit a session
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes session submission and evaluation workflow, supporting speaker registration/submission intent.

evaluations.evidence: submit a session ... get my session evaluated
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes acceptance/approval and notifications, providing complementary evaluation workflow.

evaluations.evidence: personalize my sponsorship page
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes becoming a sponsor and sponsor detail/listing features, so a sponsorship page exists to personalize.

evaluations.evidence: see a list of all the summits that include when they are
evaluations.rationale: Requires summits with date/time data to exist. Backlog lacks an explicit summit creation/maintenance story establishing summit entities and their scheduling fields.

evaluations.evidence: offered several choices of individual sponsorship on the second page of registration
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes individual sponsorship payment/charging and payment page steps, supporting offering choices during registration.

evaluations.evidence: find a link ... that links to the registration form
evaluations.rationale: User registration form exists, so adding a menu link is complementary.

evaluations.evidence: fill out a user registration form
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes profile viewing/updating which complements account creation.

evaluations.evidence: find session information
evaluations.rationale: Backlog includes session submission and approved session lists/schedule, providing session information to find.
